events.description:
Our engineering team had identified a backlog created by a delay in routing a small percentage of log entries into our backend analytics platform. This delay is specific to analytics ingestion, and all logs remain fully accessible without delay through the Logs Explorer.

We have scaled up internal processing capacity and restarted backend components, which has resulted in the backlog steadily decreasing. 

We will provide more information by Sunday, 2026-07-26 07:00 PDT.

events.title: Cloud Logging customers may experience delays in logs ingestion into Logs Analytics

events.description:
Storage Insights Datasets are experiencing ingestion delays, but all datasets through the 2026-07-24 snapshots are up to date and are available for querying. 

Ingestion of buckets/objects was previously delayed in multiregions/us, us-central1, and us-east5 for snapshots from 2026-07-04 through 2026-07-23, but has since recovered. 

The engineering team continues to work on mitigation.

We will provide more information by Sunday, 2026-07-26 21:00 PDT
